parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the three texts about a trip to hospital. For each question, choose the correct answer.

persons.name: Alessio
persons.text: I've never stayed in a hospital, but about a month ago I visited my friend there. He was in a room with lots of other people. I was afraid just before we went into the room, but then I saw my friend. He was smiling and didn't look ill. The doctors and nurses were really kind and my friend got better quickly. He said being in hospital was OK, but I'm not sure. There's nothing to do except sleep and watch TV.

persons.name: Selim
persons.text: I went to the hospital when my little sister was born. Mum stayed there for a night and we visited the next day. Dad asked me if I was scared about going to a hospital, but I was just excited about meeting my sister. The hospital was interesting. The doctor told me that little babies can't see well, which I didn't know before. I asked Mum if she wanted me to wash the baby with her, but we did that when we took her home.

persons.name: Esteban
persons.text: I had to go to hospital when I broke my leg. I was there for two days. I met another boy there, and we talked and played together so we didn't get bored. I taught him to play cards. I still see him sometimes. My leg hurt, but the doctors gave me medicine to take the pain away and showed me pictures of my leg, called X-rays. I think I'd like to do their job. It's good to help people when they're ill.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.passage:
A short history of glasses

People haven't always (1) .......... glasses. History books say there weren't any reading glasses when the Italian writer Seneca was born in 4BC, for example. So how did people with bad eyes read without them? Seneca looked (2) .......... a drinking glass!

We've known for a long time that the sun can (3) .......... our eyes. The Chinese first used sunglasses about 2,000 years ago. In the north of Canada, the sunlight on the snow is very strong in spring when the sun is (4) .......... in the sky. People put (5) .......... of wood over their eyes before they had sunglasses there.

People didn't start to use glasses to see better until much later. People (6) .......... that the first pair of glasses was made in Italy in about 1284.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 6
parts.instructions: Read the email from your English friend, Robyn. Write an email to Robyn and answer the questions. Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
From: Robyn

I've started going to the gym to keep fit. What activity do you do to keep fit? Who do you usually do it with? How long have you done it for?

checklist.band5: All three questions are answered clearly and with relevant detail.
checklist.band3: Two questions answered, or answers lack detail.
checklist.band1: Only one question answered or content is mostly irrelevant.

checklist.band5: The email is well-organised with a greeting, clear answers and a sign-off.
checklist.band3: Some organisation but may lack greeting/sign-off or answers are not clearly separated.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Hard to follow.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer:
Dear Robyn,
To keep fit I go swimming at my local pool once a week. I usually go with my friend Jana. We've done it for about three months.
Best wishes,
Marta

parts.title: Listening Part 3
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Alissa talking to her friend Joey about a Healthy Living Day at a sports centre.

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: How was your Healthy Living Day, Alissa?

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: Great! My cousin Georgia and I learned about living in a healthy way, and tried some different sports.

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: Were you tired afterwards?

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: Georgia was, and she didn't feel well. I was OK but <u>I needed something to drink</u>. I forgot to take anything!

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: Was it expensive?

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: No, £20 for adults, and £15 for under 16s. But we're members, so <u>it was only £10</u> for us.

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: I think I'd like to do a Healthy Living Day.

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: You! Why?

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: It's different from the things I usually do. All that exercise! <u>I need to do more of that!</u> And if you and Georgia go again, I'll be with friends. When's the next day?

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: I've booked a place for <u>July 5th</u> but the next one is actually on 28th May. They're always on Saturdays.

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: I'm free most Saturdays after 14th June, so I'll come to the one you booked. Can you do climbing there?

script.speaker: Alissa
script.text: They don't have a wall, unfortunately. I'm going to do hockey, and Georgia wants to try <u>skateboarding</u>.

script.speaker: Joey
script.text: I like Georgia's idea – <u>it sounds the best!</u>

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.passage:
Medicine for my headache

I have just returned from a holiday in the mountains of Peru. I (1) .......... walking with my family. My parents have (2) .......... me on other holidays in mountain areas, but the mountains in Peru are the highest I've (3) .......... seen.

One day, we walked through a beautiful old village. I had a headache because we were so high up in the mountains. I started to talk to a woman who lived there, and told her about my headache. She went to a plant that was (4) .......... near us, picked a few flowers from it and made some tea with them in her kitchen. She gave me the tea and it made me feel (5) .......... . Soon, my head stopped (6) .......... . I was so glad I talked to that woman!

parts.title: Listening Part 3
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Christina talking to her friend Leo about a health problem.

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: Hello, Leo.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: What's the matter, Christina?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: I've hurt my back, Leo.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Oh no! Have you seen the doctor?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: Not yet. But I'm going to.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: This morning?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: No, I couldn't get an appointment – <u>I'm going tomorrow afternoon</u>. So I won't be at school until Thursday.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: How did you do it?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: Well, I walked home after basketball practice yesterday, and then it happened <u>when I was going upstairs</u> to the flat.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Really? So where are you now?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: At home, lying down. Not on my bed, <u>in the living room, on the sofa</u>. Mum's here, making lunch in the kitchen.

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: So what activities can you do? You can't come skateboarding this evening, can you?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: Mum says no, <u>which I'm not pleased about</u>. But swimming's OK – it may help. I'm not having my guitar lesson this evening, but that's fine!

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: Would you like something to read? I've got some good books about famous people.

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: OK – but I don't want to read about film actors. Maybe something about a pop star?

script.speaker: Leo
script.text: I've got nothing like that. There's one about <u>a footballer</u> – what about that?

script.speaker: Christina
script.text: Brilliant. Thanks, Leo.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the three texts about health and the body projects. For each question, choose the correct answer.

persons.name: Kemal
persons.text: For my project, I had to find out about our teeth, mouth and stomach. I had to find pictures of them and explain what happens to food, from the moment we put it in our mouths to when it goes into our stomachs. Then I gave a talk about it all to my class. Writing the project was interesting and I learned a lot about the body, but I didn't like giving the talk – I felt really worried before I did that.

persons.name: Dan
persons.text: I did a project about why and how we get some health problems, such as colds, having a temperature, toothache and pain. With all the information I found, I had to make a web page for teenagers to use. I enjoyed doing the project, especially the talk to my class at the end. After the talk, I gave them a quiz and they answered everything really well. Perhaps I should be a teacher in the future!

persons.name: Jerzy
persons.text: My project was about what you should do when people get ill suddenly or hurt themselves, so it was really useful. For example, I now know how to help a friend who has cut himself badly, or a family member who has broken an arm or a leg. I had to write a ten-page document for teenagers. I found most of the information I needed online. One thing the project taught me is that I certainly don't want to be a doctor or a nurse when I'm older!
